sections.heading: Find your equipment
sections.body: Use category, rarity, search and sorting controls to find an item. Equipment shows its Rank and Style; select it to review its stats, ownership and available actions.

sections.heading: Equip your loadout
sections.body: Equip your chosen hands, armor and accessories from Inventory. Equipping updates your active attributes. Old items in the Tool slot can still be removed, but gathering tools are no longer part of your progression.

sections.heading: Improve or salvage
sections.body: Open Equipment & Forge to improve Rank, apply a learned style or salvage equipment. Review the preview before confirming. Unequip equipment before salvage; the return uses its saved award value and actual paid rank Scrap. Cinders and style fees are not refunded.
